When you close or unsubscribe the library will halt messages in any pending queue or cache for subscribers. When you drain a subscription or connection, it will process any inflight and cached/pending messages before closing. Drain provides clients that use queue subscriptions with a way to bring down applications without losing any messages. Therefore, the practical difference is that draining ensures any messages in the pending queues or cache are processed before the connection is closed, whereas closing simply halts messages in pending queues or cache without processing them first.
